regionalIdentity.saveCompatibility: Existing pcg_havenwild_mainland_* scene IDs remain unchanged. Alderreach is the player-facing landmass name.

storagePolicy: Exterior scene rectangles are storage partitions, never roads, city districts, landmass edges, or player-facing scenes.

newWorldScale.legacySavePolicy: Generation-version migration does not resize an occupied world. Explicit world regeneration is required to receive the expanded landmass.

resources.districtExclusion: Natural scatter may not occupy any reserved civic, market, residential, artisan, harbor, agricultural, cave, or public-path zone.

routes: Willowmere Harbor dry-land approach to Willowmere
Willowmere to promoted cave host when available
roads.harborTermination: Ordinary road terrain must terminate on dry coastal land. Boardwalk, seawall, dock, bridge, and pier assets own all later over-water traversal.

willowmere.implementedStage: global capital site, street framework, compact civic plaza, invisible district and building-lot reservations, and civic object anchors
willowmere.lotVisualPolicy: Reserved lots are metadata only and may not paint giant StonePath rectangles.

civicPlaza.purpose: small visible public square rather than building-footprint placeholders

willowmere.quarantinedMisclassification: assets/source/licensed/lpc_revised/Objects/Furniture/Water Cooler.png must never bind to ObjectKind::Well
willowmere.fullBuildingStampStatus: blocked until external ElizaWy/OpenGameArt LPC structure sheets pass semantic, footprint, license, and attribution promotion

harbor.implementedStage: dry coastal landfall, invisible harbor district reservation, and road approach
harbor.waterProtection: Migration restores road cells that intruded into heavily water-adjacent shoreline cells.

caves.hostRule: contiguous high-elevation mountain-rock face with audited 4x4 placement clearance
caves.transitionStatus: entrance host is materialized; dedicated per-cave instance routing remains follow-on

cliffs.renderStatus: Exact seasonal source sheets remain audited but require full source remount and promotion; placeholders and mixed-style pixels remain forbidden.

toolActions.movementPolicy: stop while player_action_remaining is positive, play mapped action, then restore normal movement input
toolActions.repeatInputPolicy: ignore additional tool-use clicks while the action timer owns the character

artPolicy.missingAuthoredPixels: block promotion and report the exact source/semantic gap
